meta.title: MDCC Certificate Generation & Dispatch Clearance: refused for a user without the Quality Inspector role
gaps: MDCC Certificate Generation and Dispatch Clearance, including generating an MDCC from a passed inspection, is not represented by any catalog step.
Signing in as both a non-Quality Inspector and a Quality Inspector to compare role-based availability is not supported by the catalog.
Verifying the tenant is on the Enterprise plan is not supported without a named QA tenant or plan-setting step.

steps.note: Open the closest available existing event page before the tester performs the passed-inspection and MDCC workflow.

args.need: sign in as the non-Quality-Inspector user and the Quality Inspector on the Enterprise tenant, open a passed inspection, attempt MDCC Certificate Generation and Dispatch Clearance for both roles, and record whether the action is refused or available
